programme.title: SOS Automóvel T13 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O Car SOS trata de um Suzuki Jimny 4x4. Propriedade de Joanna, enfermeira reformada do Serviço Nacional de Saúde e mãe dedicada, este pequeno carro tem uma avaria na caixa de velocidades que nem a Suzuki consegue reparar.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz enfrentam uma missão ousada: resgatar um Frogeye Sprite escondido numa garagem há mais de 50 anos, agora enferrujado, bloqueado e em mau estado. Com um serralheiro a caminho, conseguirão restaurá-lo a tempo de uma emocionante revelação numa vinha, com a ajuda surpresa de Dame Joanna Lumley? O tempo urge.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Aproveite esta impressionante oportunidade de ver como se produz um Ford Mustang, onde são feitas quatro versões diferentes, incluíndo o super poderoso V8 de 650 cavalos.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Um olhar mais aprofundado pelas mais variadas marcas do mundo inteiro, e uma incrível viagem através da linha de montagem em cada uma destas autênticas Mega Fábricas.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Entre as pessoas que foram passar o fim de semana fora e as que regressam a casa vindas do trabalho, a sexta-feira é sempre um dia movimentado no aeroporto. Mais passageiros significa mais problemas, o que deixa os gerentes de turno em alerta máximo. Hoje há uma emergência de ambulância aérea, falhas de segurança, drogas ilegais e um passageiro que grita e enfrenta uma proibição por parte da companhia aérea para a qual tem voo marcado.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Acabadinho de sair de nove meses de treino na Academia da Guarda de Proteção de Fronteiras, o Labrador Warner enfrenta o seu primeiro dia de trabalho como farejador de droga. Os gestores de segurança testam as suas equipas de rastreio tentando fazer passar por elas uma bomba falsa. Annie enfrenta o seu momento da verdade. Conseguirá passar no teste e tornar-se numa agente de rastreio qualificada?.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O Aeroporto de Sydney é uma cidade dentro de uma cidade, com milhares de colaboradores a manter tudo a funcionar.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Sydney T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: A quadra natalícia, tipicamente frenética, traz desafios extra com muitas famílias a sair de Sydney por motivo de férias. Contudo, o aeroporto está em risco de ser encerrado com a descoberta de um pó branco não identificado a bordo de um voo que chegará ao aeroporto. Cresce a especulação sobre se se tratará de um pó inofensivo, ou antraz, a arma terrorista letal.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Neste episódio mostramos-lhe as várias formas como se pode envergonhar, magoar e humilhar enquanto dança no varão, brinca com um pula-pula e corta uma árvore. .

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Neste episódio mostramos-lhe as várias formas como se pode envergonhar, magoar e humilhar enquanto anda sobre gelo, guia um carrinho de compras ou simplesmente decide desvalorizar as correntes elétricas. .

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea espetacular pelo Reino Unido mostra a limpeza de um arranha-céus, a criação de ovelhas nos lagos e um estaleiro de reparação de uma plataforma petrolífera.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea espetacular por Espanha mostra apanhadores de percebes cheios de coragem, engenharia de ponta na Andaluzia e uma visita ao projeto de construção mais longo, em Barcelona.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Esta viagem aérea espetacular pela Turquia mostra-nos balões de ar quente em Cappadocia, uma ponte que bate recordes e os últimos nómadas da Europa.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Safári T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Num final épico, Hazen Audel viaja até ao mato do Serengeti enquanto tenta atingir o seu objetivo: observar a Grande Migração de gnus.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: O Poderoso Rio Mekong T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Do ponto mais elevado da Bacia Mekong, Hazen Audel desce pela floresta nebulosa em busca do povo Hmong, que caça com recurso a venenos antigos e ferramentas artesanais provenientes do que restou da Guerra do Vietname.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: O Poderoso Rio Mekong T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Hazen Audel mergulha num mundo de tesouros naturais, em busca de cogumelos preciosos que crescem nas nas florestas antigas de Laos após meses de monções.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A equipa procura relíquias esquecidas num moinho do século XVIII em Westminster, Maryland, que está abandonado há décadas.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Jay, Dan e Mark, especialistas em restauração de casas, dirigem-se à zona histórica de Filadélfia para explorar uma igreja e escola góticas abandonadas.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A equipa explora uma fábrica de papel desativada, mas Jay tem de conquistar a confiança dos proprietários e provar que também ele quer preservar a história do edifício.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A equipa vai em busca de tesouros num moinho de seda abandonado. Contudo, o proprietário está muito ligado ao moinho e parece não querer desfazer-se de nada.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A equipa procura história perdida numa propriedade abandonada. Jay negoceia com os proprietários, que se revelam muito desafiantes.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A equipa procura relíquias esquecidas num moinho do século XVIII em Westminster, Maryland, que está abandonado há décadas.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A equipa encontra um conjunto de equipamentos vintage pertencentes a uma bomba de gasolina. Contudo, o talento de Jay para negociar será posto à prova antes de poderem levar consigo os artigos.

programme.title: Casas Abandonadas T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: A equipa explora uma fábrica de papel desativada, mas Jay tem de conquistar a confiança dos proprietários e provar que também ele quer preservar a história do edifício.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No aeroporto de Dulles, nos arredores da capital, a Alfândega e Proteção das Fronteiras verifica a existência de contrabando e encontra uma grande quantidade de marijuana, numa altura em que os EUA se tornam num país de origem de certas drogas. Em El Paso, o Serviço de Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras descobre pacotes de cocaína dentro de um para-choques e desmantela um veículo cheio de metanfetaminas.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T8 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: As Investigações de Segurança Interna seguem um camião de carga de San Diego para Los Angeles e descobrem cocaína escondida num carregamento de polpa de abacate congelada. Em Newark, a Alfândega e Proteção das Fronteiras descobre cogumelos psicadélicos enviados pelo correio e apreende carros roubados no porto marítimo.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T8 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Agentes da Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras dos EUA no Vale do Rio Grande interrompem as operações portuárias em McAllen depois de detetarem uma potencial ameaça de bomba. Agentes da Segurança Interna conduzem uma operação com vista à detenção de traficantes de fentanil em San Diego.

programme.title: Como Apanhar Um Traficante T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: As Investigações de Segurança Interna em San Diego seguem um veículo suspeito durante 48 horas, levando-os a um esconderijo. A Alfândega e Proteção das Fronteiras examina meticulosamente os viajantes que saem do Aeroporto Internacional de Dulles em busca de dinheiro não declarado.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os habitantes do Alasca defendem o seu estilo de vida de subsistência de predadores próximos e distantes. Os Brown tentam proteger a sua quinta quando os sinais da presença de lobos estão cada vez mais perto. Johnny Rolfe pensa num novo design de casaco para Java, a sua companheira de quatro patas.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os habitantes do Alasca têm de se preparar para tudo o que a Mãe Natureza lhes reserve. Johnny Rolfe leva Java para longe do acampamento para caçar, mas é apanhado de surpresa por uma manada de renas, enquanto a família Roach, depois de muitas tentativas, consegue apanhar peixe-preto.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: A próxima geração de habitantes do Alasca arrisca as suas vidas durante o inverno rigoroso para manter o equilíbrio da terra, garantir comida e ajudar os outros em tempos de necessidade. Johnny Rolfe tem de ser astuto para caçar renas e encher a sua reserva de carne. Kaleb Rowland ajuda um vizinho a mover um veículo por trilhos traiçoeiros. Chevie Roach aventura-se longe de casa para salvar uma manada de bisontes-das-florestas.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A próxima geração de habitantes do Alasca usa o seu engenho para ultrapassar o inverno rigoroso. Johnny Rolfe depara-se com a lei de Murphy enquanto pescava e tem de reparar a sua máquina de neve. Chevie Roach e o filho, Ryder, ajudam a restaurar o camião de bombeiros da comunidade que não funciona há décadas. Kaleb está determinado a montar uma cabana de pesca móvel para manter os filhos quentes.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A próxima geração tem de desbravar terreno agreste e desconhecido de modo a subsistir no Ártico. Mario tenta, com dificuldade, encontrar alimento nas White Mountains, enquanto a família Rowland enfrenta terrenos traiçoeiros para pescar dolly varden. A família Sarvela prepara-se para a estação seguinte, construindo uma estufa, enquanto Chevie Roach parte para um novo local na esperança de expandir os seus terrenos de caça.

programme.title: Titanic: 25 Anos Depois com James Cameron - Ep. 1
programme.desc: James Cameron reúne especialistas para o ajudar a explorar os mitos e mistérios do naufrágio, e acrescenta um posfácio à sua história de ficção sobre a tragédia. Dada a insistência dos fãs em que Jack não tinha de morrer naquela noite, o realizador executa testes para determinar, de uma vez por todas, se Jack e Rose poderiam caber ambos naquela jangada e sobreviver.

programme.title: Destruição Descodificada T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Do desastre da ponte pedonal de Morbi em 2022 à tragédia do edifício de Savar em 2013, explore os 10 colapsos mais dramáticos da história e o seu impacto global.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O Aeroporto de Toronto leva a preparação e a segurança a sério: mecânicos, bombeiros e até um cão em treino para afugentar aves são postos à prova.

programme.title: Grandes Máquinas Do Mar T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Num estaleiro de desmantelamento no Lago Erie, um cargueiro dos Grandes Lagos, danificado por um incêndio, chega para a sua última missão. Uma equipa familiar trabalha contra o tempo para tornar o navio seguro, desmantelá-lo para aproveitar o aço e transformar o risco em lucro, enquanto a volatilidade dos preços da sucata, as margens reduzidas e os perigos ambientais condicionam cada decisão. .

programme.title: Hitler: Alvo A Abater T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Especialistas exploram as tentativas de assassinato de Adolf Hitler levadas a cabo por indivíduos isolados, usando análises científicas, recriações dramáticas e arquivos raros.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A forensic look at how wolf packs hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the way they work together to locate, isolate and bring down large bison and musk oxen. An arctic wolf pack must make a kill before the harsh winter arrives, while further south, grey wolves take on prey 10 times their size.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way these silent killers stalk and ambush everything from impala to wildebeest and catfish to storks. A female leopard deploys stealth, strength and agility to take down prey on land, in water and from the air.

Meanwhile on the tundra, a pregnant mother bear returns to the land where she and her ancestors were born.

programme.title: Kingdom Of The Polar Bears T1 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony of Psalms
programme.desc: German conductor Wolfgang Gönnenwein leads the Orchester der Ludwigsburger Schloßfestspiele and the Süddeutscher Madrigalchor Stuttgart in a performance of Igor Stravinsky’s Symphony of Psalms (1930). The composer included verses from Psalms 38, 39, and 150 from the Vulgate bible in Latin in his work, which was written for mixed chorus and orchestra. The three movements of the symphony are performed without break.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 16
programme.desc: Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos's String Quartet No. 16 at the Palácio das Laranjeiras in Rio de Janiero, Brasil. The ensemble was founded in 2006 and consists of Carla Rincón and Francisco Roa (violins), Fernando Thebaldi (viola), and Hugo Pilger (cello). The quartet, which specializes in Brazilian music, focuses on educational activities.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Mussorgsky/Ravel - Pictures at an Exhibition
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello).

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos.

programme.title: Josquin - Missa L'homme armé sexti toni
programme.desc: ‘Beware the armed man!’ The warning about ‘L’homme armé’ sounds twice as powerful from the mouth of Josquin Desprez: he twice used the popular medieval melody as the basis for composing a mass. Earlier in this Festival, the Missa super voces musicales was performed by Marco Mencoboni and Katharina Bäuml; today Lionel Meunier is the duty chef, with the brilliant Missa Sexti toni, in which the melody keeps popping up all over the place.

programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolinska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky’s semi-autobiographical symphony.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler and Schönberg
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Concerto & Academic Ouverture
programme.desc: One of today’s most distinguished conductors, Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in a performance featuring works from the oeuvre of Johannes Brahms. The concert begins with the Academic Festival Overture, written in honor of the University of Breslau, which awarded the composer an honorary doctorate in philosophy.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008
programme.desc: This stunning, new interpretation of Cinderella, is a theatrical ice dancing performance not to be missed.This story of Cinderella focuses on a humble chorus dancer who is thrust into the spotlight, captivates the heart of the most eligible bachelor in town, and despite rival attempts by her stepsisters to steal his heart, shows viewers that true love always triumphs.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 3, Op. 90
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in this performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 3. A late-romantic treasure, this work demonstrates the evolution of the composer's modest symphonic output, balancing the brightness of his Second Symphony with the monumentality of his Fourth Symphony.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: LBT - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. Among the artists of 2019 is the German Leo Betzl Trio.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Set 2
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: Tania Maria: Live at Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This performance of Brazilian Tania Maria promises to make you want to dance.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets & Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano & Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Spiral
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Arsenik - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: RY X
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Mohamed Abozekry
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Hall & Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney’s Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater’ began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up.

programme.title: Moondog & The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Festival Vue sur la Relève: SHPIK
programme.desc: Montreal's very own jazz group SHPIK offers a bold and impressionistic music, drawing its inspirations from jazz, nature, and film. Evoking the great outdoors, self-discovery, and navigating between the immense and the infinitely small, this first album offers an intricate musical journey that is both energetic and reflective.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Wynton Marsalis
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: George Michael - Live in London
programme.desc: George Michael winds down his 25 Live tour in his first-ever concert film, which finds the former Wham! leading man revisiting hits familiar and fresh in two sold-out shows at London's Earls Court. Michael's impeccable vocals take center stage, and his pop-song prowess is driven home with such classics as 'Faith', 'Freedom' and 'One More Try'. Even 'Careless Whisper' gets a nod, as does the Police's 'Roxanne'.

programme.title: Leon Bridges - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary
programme.desc: 'Songs From Tsongas' is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: AC/DC - Hell’s Highway
programme.desc: Watch AC/DC members deliver their signature high-voltage sound in this live performance.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Ellie Goulding - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Do not just be fascinated by the beauty and girlishness of this bright-eyed Englishwoman. Ellie Goulding has a lot more to offer fans of good pop music and its electronic variations. Since releasing her first album in 2010, Ellie has traveled the world to showcase her talents, both in the voice and in the composition of her songs.

programme.title: Pet Shop Boys - Live at Roskilde 2009
programme.desc: Filmed in Roskilde, Denmark, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Pet Shop Boys featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Always On My Mind', 'West End Girls', 'Being Boring' and many more...

programme.title: Alice In Chains - Alice in Chains - Unplugged
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of the hit songs 'Got Me Wrong,' 'Rooster,' 'Would?,' and 'Down in a Hole.'.

programme.title: Bring Me the Horizon - Reading & Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Bring Me The Horizon.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - A MusiCaresTribute
programme.desc: The unmistakable Paul McCartney was honored as 'Person of the Year' by MusiCares at a gala event that brought together several artists to celebrate the Beatles' victorious career.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: The Who - Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Charlie Puth - Live in London 2015
programme.desc: Charlie Puth performs during the 2015 Apple Music Festival at The Roundhouse on September 20, 2015 in London, England.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Metallica - Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.desc: Filmed at Orion Festival, Atlantic City, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Metallica featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'One', 'Master Of Puppets', 'Sad But True', 'Seek & Destroy' and many more.

programme.title: Beyoncé - Sound of Change
programme.desc: The Sound Of Change was a benefit concert held at Twickenham Stadium, London, England, as part of the Chime For Change initiative, founded by Beyoncé with the help of actress Salma Hayek and Gucci's creative director, Frida Giannini.

programme.title: Adele - iTunes Festival: Live in London
programme.desc: Fans at the iTunes Festival: London 2011 were blown away with the performance of English singer-songwriter Adele. This concert was recorded live on stage at The Roundhouse in London, United Kingdom, where Adele gave one of the best shows of her career with her unique voice.

programme.title: Mary J. Blige - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Duran Duran - The Reunion Tour: Live at Wembley
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Rio', 'Hungry Like The Wolf', 'The Reflex' and many more….

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from Garden Grove, California, formed in 1984. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan 'Dexter' Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin 'Noodles' Wasserman.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 31
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 65
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 32

Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Le Refuge D'Audrey T1 - Ep. 15
